display.name: Calendar Sync Health
display.description: Destination reconciliation health, failure blast radius, source-ingest health, and infrastructure rollback signals. In-sync reconciliations are explicitly counted; repeated attempts are separated from unique affected users/calendars.

display.name: provider
display.description: Provider (provider.name)

display.name: plan
display.description: User plan (user.plan)

display.name: In-Sync Reconciliations
display.description: Actual provider reconciliations that required no mutations. This is the dominant healthy outcome.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'in-sync'

display.name: Changed Successfully
display.description: Actual reconciliations that completed mutations successfully.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success'

display.name: Preflight / Job Failures
display.description: Jobs that failed before emitting a sync:calendar result: credentials, database access, provider setup, and similar failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'push-sync' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Reconciliation Partial / Error
display.description: Failures after a provider reconciliation started.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$')

display.name: Affected Calendars
display.description: Distinct destination calendars with a partial/error result or preflight failure.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$')

display.name: Affected Users
display.description: Distinct users affected; repeated retries do not inflate this number.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$')

display.name: Webhook Time to Reflect
display.description: Elapsed time from receiving a provider webhook to the destination sync for it completing (push_sync.reflect_ms on the worker's sync:calendar event). The 'wrote a change' line only counts syncs with operations.total > 0, over 1h buckets.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'p50' AS q, quantile(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND position(body, 'sync:calendar') > 0 AND position(body, 'reflect_ms') > 0 AND JSONHas(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms') GROUP BY ts, q ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'p90' AS q, quantile(0.9)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND position(body, 'sync:calendar') > 0 AND position(body, 'reflect_ms') > 0 AND JSONHas(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms') GROUP BY ts, q ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'p99' AS q, quantile(0.99)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND position(body, 'sync:calendar') > 0 AND position(body, 'reflect_ms') > 0 AND JSONHas(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms') GROUP BY ts, q ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(3600, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'p50 — wrote a change' AS q, quantile(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND position(body, 'sync:calendar') > 0 AND position(body, 'reflect_ms') > 0 AND JSONHas(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms') AND JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['operations'], 'total') > 0 GROUP BY ts, q ORDER BY ts)

display.name: Webhook Time to Reflect (p90)
display.description: p90 across the selected range. Elapsed time from receiving a provider webhook to the destination sync for it completing (push_sync.reflect_ms on the worker's sync:calendar event).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT quantile(0.9)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND position(body, 'sync:calendar') > 0 AND position(body, 'reflect_ms') > 0 AND JSONHas(attributes_string['push_sync'], 'reflect_ms')

display.name: Ingest Duration (median) by Provider
display.description: Median end-to-end ingest per source calendar, split by provider. Provider I/O dominates this number, so a single provider inflating while the others hold steady points at that provider rather than at the fleet. Pinning at 120s means sources are burning their whole deadline.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS p, quantile(0.5)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND position(body, 'ingest-source') > 0 AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') != '' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY ts, p ORDER BY ts

display.name: Rate Limiter Wait (p90) by Provider
display.description: Time waiting on a provider permit, split by provider. Each provider is governed by a different limiter, so the split is the only way to tell which limiter is actually binding.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS p, quantile(0.9)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['wait'], 'rate_limiter_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND position(body, 'ingest-source') > 0 AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') != '' AND JSONHas(attributes_string['wait'], 'rate_limiter_ms') GROUP BY ts, p ORDER BY ts

display.name: Slot Wait (median) by Lane
display.description: Queueing before a calendar starts ingesting, split by lane rather than by provider: slot wait is internal contention, not provider latency.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['ingest'], 'trigger') AS t, quantile(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['concurrency'], 'slot_wait_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND position(body, 'ingest-source') > 0 AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['ingest'], 'trigger') != '' AND JSONHas(attributes_string['concurrency'], 'slot_wait_ms') GROUP BY ts, t ORDER BY ts

display.name: Ingest Error Share by Provider
display.description: Share of ingest runs ending in error, split by provider. Matches on the top-level outcome field rather than a raw line match. A provider with traffic and no errors plots a flat zero.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS p, countIf(attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error') / count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND position(body, 'ingest-source') > 0 AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') != '' GROUP BY ts, p ORDER BY ts

display.name: Destination Reconciliation Outcomes
display.description: Only actual sync:calendar reconciliations. In-sync, success, partial, and error are shown together.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) GROUP BY ts, user_plan, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Destination Failure Attempts by Cause
display.description: Repeated attempts are intentionally visible here; use Affected Users/Calendars for blast radius.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS error_slug, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$') GROUP BY ts, error_slug ORDER BY ts

display.name: Top Users by Failed Attempts
display.description: Shows concentration and retry amplification; this is attempt count, not unique failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user_id, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$') GROUP BY user_plan, user_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

display.name: Top Calendars by Failed Attempts
display.description: Repeated failures for the same destination are grouped together.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar_id, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user_id, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$') GROUP BY provider_name, calendar_id, user_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

display.name: Destination Mutations
display.description: Destination mutations only (sync.events_added / sync.events_removed summed per bucket); source-ingest changes are not mixed into this chart.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(60, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'Added' AS series, sum(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['sync'], 'events_added')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(60, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'Removed' AS series, sum(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['sync'], 'events_removed')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts)

display.name: P95 Destination Reconciliation Duration
display.description: Provider reconciliation duration, excluding preflight failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider_name, quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY ts, provider_name ORDER BY ts

display.name: Calendars Replacing Repeatedly
display.description: Destination calendars with stale replacements in more than one reconciliation during the selected range.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar_id, count() AS c FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) AND JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'count') > 0 GROUP BY calendar_id HAVING c > 1)

display.name: Stale Mapping Replacements
display.description: Total mapping replacement decisions in the selected range. Repeated loops accumulate here.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT sum(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'count')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) AND JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'count') > 0

display.name: Stale Mapping Reasons
display.description: Non-exclusive reasons a mapped destination event was replaced, summed per bucket. A mapping can contribute to more than one reason.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT ts, pair.1 AS reason, sum(pair.2) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(60, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, arrayJoin([('remote content changed', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'remote_content_changed_count')), ('remote time changed', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'remote_time_changed_count')), ('remote missing', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'remote_missing_count')), ('local hash changed', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'local_hash_changed_count')), ('remote availability changed', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'remote_availability_changed_count')), ('occurrence reassigned', JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'occurrence_reassigned_count'))]) AS pair FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name')))) GROUP BY ts, reason ORDER BY ts

display.name: Top Calendars by Stale Replacements
display.description: Total stale mapping replacements by destination calendar. Use the repeated-calendar stat to distinguish loops from one-time legitimate changes.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar_id, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS user_plan, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user_id, sum(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'count')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND (hasAll({{.plan}}, ['free', 'pro']) OR has({{.plan}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan'))) AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) AND JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['stale_mappings'], 'count') > 0 GROUP BY provider_name, calendar_id, user_plan, user_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

display.name: DB Connection Timeouts
display.description: Raw and structured database connection-starvation signals.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] IN ('keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-api') AND match(body, 'ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT|Connection timeout after 30s')

display.name: Sync Deadlines
display.description: Destination jobs that reached the configured overall deadline.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') = 'sync-deadline-exceeded'

display.name: Lock / FK / Recurrence Failures
display.description: Correctness-critical lock renewal, foreign-key, and recurrence materialization failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] IN ('keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker') AND match(body, 'sync-lock-renewal-failed|foreign key|ForeignKey|recurrence-materialization-limit|recurrence material')

display.name: Provider Throttles / 429
display.description: Structured rate-limit and Outlook mailbox-concurrency failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] IN ('keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker') AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND match(body, 'provider-rate-limited|MailboxConcurrency|ApplicationThrottled')

display.name: Users Requiring Reauth
display.description: Distinct affected users, not repeated calendar attempts.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] IN ('keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker') AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug'), '^(provider-auth-failed|provider-token-refresh-failed)$')

display.name: Failed Enqueue Runs
display.description: Cron destination-enumeration failures; these mean an entire free/pro tick enqueued no work.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-destinations.*)$') AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Source Ingest Outcomes by Provider
display.description: Per-calendar source results. Parent AggregateError noise is excluded.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-source' AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) GROUP BY ts, provider_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Source Ingest Failures by Cause
display.description: Per-calendar failure causes, including permanent authentication failures and transient provider errors.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS error_slug, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-source' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' AND (hasAll({{.provider}}, ['google', 'outlook', 'caldav', 'fastmail', 'icloud', 'ical']) OR has({{.provider}}, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name'))) GROUP BY ts, provider_name, error_slug ORDER BY ts

display.name: Source Calendars Succeeded
display.description: Per-calendar successes; unlike the parent job outcome, these writes committed.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-source' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success'

display.name: Source Calendars Failed
display.description: Per-calendar failures. Compare with succeeded rather than treating the parent AggregateError as total failure.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-source' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Parent Runs Reporting Child Failures
display.description: Current code marks the entire run error when any source fails; this is not a rollback of successful sources.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-sources' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Longest Source Run
display.description: Wall-clock duration of the slowest monolithic source-ingest pass.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT max(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-sources' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms')

display.name: Destination Jobs Enqueued
display.description: Jobs accepted for each plan, summed per bucket. Missing points paired with Failed Enqueue Runs indicate a missed scheduling tick.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(60, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['batch'], 'plan') AS batch_plan, sum(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['batch'], 'jobs_enqueued')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-destinations.*)$') AND JSONHas(attributes_string['batch'], 'jobs_enqueued') GROUP BY ts, batch_plan ORDER BY ts

display.name: Source Parent Run Duration
display.description: Shows whether the nominal one-minute source job is actually taking multiple minutes.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'ingest-sources' AS series, max(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-sources' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

display.name: Recent Destination Errors
display.description: Destination errors, including both preflight failures and provider reconciliation failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS op, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS slug, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'plan') AS plan FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync:calendar)$') AND match(attributes_string['outcome'], '^(partial|error)$') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

display.name: Recent Source / Scheduling Errors
display.description: Source-calendar, parent-ingest, and destination-enqueue errors.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS op, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS slug, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['provider'], 'name') AS provider, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

display.name: Source Fleet Coverage — % of Polled Calendars Ingested (Pull)
display.description: Distinct source calendars from keeper-cron ingest-source events. 'Fleet seen 6h' = calendars that emitted any ingest event in the past 6h; 'Connected' / 'Synced' = at least one successful ingest in the window. Windows are fixed (6h/1h/30m/5m/1m back from now) and ignore the time picker and the provider/plan variables. Percentages use 'Fleet seen 6h' as the denominator. Ingest runs in bursts, so 5m and 1m sawtooth with scheduler phase; 30m and 1h are the meaningful health numbers.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) AS `Fleet seen 6h`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 21600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') AS `Connected 6h`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 21600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `Connected %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') AS `Synced ≤1h`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤1h %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 1800 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') AS `Synced ≤30m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 1800 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤30m %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') AS `Synced ≤5m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤5m %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') AS `Synced ≤1m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'success') / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤1m %` FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start >= toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(now()) - 21600 - 1800) AND timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'ingest-source' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') != ''

display.name: Destination Fleet Coverage — % of Active Calendars Reconciled (Push)
display.description: Distinct destination calendars from keeper-worker sync:calendar events. 'Fleet seen 6h' = calendars with any sync attempt in the past 6h; 'Connected' / 'Synced' = at least one in-sync or success reconciliation in the window. Windows are fixed (6h/1h/30m/5m/1m back from now) and ignore the time picker and the provider/plan variables. Percentages use 'Fleet seen 6h' as the denominator. Ingest runs in bursts, so 5m and 1m sawtooth with scheduler phase; 30m and 1h are the meaningful health numbers.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) AS `Fleet seen 6h`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 21600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) AS `Connected 6h`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `Connected %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) AS `Synced ≤1h`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤1h %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 1800 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) AS `Synced ≤30m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 1800 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤30m %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) AS `Synced ≤5m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤5m %`, uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) AS `Synced ≤1m`, round(if(uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR)) = 0, 0, 100 * uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AND attributes_string['outcome'] IN ('in-sync', 'success')) / uniqExactIf(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id'), timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), 1) AS `≤1m %` FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start >= toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(now()) - 21600 - 1800) AND timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') = 'sync:calendar' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') != ''
